title: Plumeform CTA band (v2)
description: A soft vertical mint wash on paper holding one large dark card with 28px corners and a long shadow: a backdrop slot inside, then a centred eyebrow, a heavy two-line headline, a paper pill button beside an underlined link, and a small slate note. The backdrop fades in and the content rises and un-blurs as it comes into view.
notes: the card is dark by itself (dark class); its backdrop is a placeholder until given a video or WebGL scene
